description: This donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different stimulus types used in the study, with each segment corresponding to a specific category and its percentage share. The chart contains eight distinct slices, each labeled with its category name and percentage value. The largest segment is “Press Release” at 18.7%, followed closely by “External News Article” at 18.1%. The next largest is “Interview” at 8.8%, then “Organizational Report” at 7.7%, “Event Posting” at 6.6%, and “Intra-agency news article” at 4.9%. Two smaller segments are “Organizational Website” at 4.9% and “Email” at 2.7%, and the smallest is “Social Media Post” at 1.1%. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order around the center, generally in descending order of size, and each is color-coded: “Press Release” is yellow, “External News Article” is dark green, “Interview” is dark blue, “Organizational Report” is purple, “Event Posting” is dark red, “Intra-agency news article” is light blue, “Organizational Website” is light purple, and “Email” is light green. The “Social Media Post” slice is a very thin, orange segment. Each category label is positioned outside the ring, with the percentage value in parentheses directly adjacent to the label. The chart does not include a separate legend, as the labels are directly associated with their respective segments. The central white area contains the title “Stimulus Type” in bold.
